name: kythira
description: Kythira - A C++ Raft consensus implementation with pluggable components

gcp.description: GCP quorum managers (Compute Engine + Managed Instance Groups), the Certificate Authority Service certificate provider, and the GCS object client. Pulls in google-cloud-cpp's compute, privateca and storage components. Opt-in via --x-feature=gcp: the compute component builds the entire Compute API surface (large), so it is kept out of the default dependency set — only the dedicated GCP CI job and operators who want the GCP backends enable it. Backs KYTHIRA_HAS_GCP_SDK / KYTHIRA_HAS_GCP_PRIVATECA / KYTHIRA_HAS_GCP_STORAGE (Requirement 1 AC 6). NOTE on 'storage': it is already in google-cloud-cpp's own default feature set, which this list never disables, so adding it here does not change what gets built today. It is listed to make the dependency intentional — gcp_gcs_client is a persistence backend, and an upstream change to that default set must not be able to remove it silently.

edhoc.description: EDHOC-to-OSCORE credential bootstrap for the CoAP transport (coap-transport-security spec's oscore_bootstrap::edhoc). Opt-in: requires a Rust toolchain (cargo/rustc) to build the lakers overlay port from source, since lakers publishes no pre-built binaries for this platform. Not part of the default install; omitting it just leaves LAKERS_AVAILABLE undefined and oscore_bootstrap::edhoc unavailable.

ion.description: Amazon Ion RPC serializer (ion_rpc_serializer, include/raft/ion_serializer.hpp). Builds ion-c from source via the vcpkg-overlays/ion-c overlay port. Opt-in: not part of the default install; omitting it leaves KYTHIRA_ION_SERIALIZER_AVAILABLE undefined and ion_rpc_serializer unavailable.

coap-cantcoap.description: Alternate cantcoap-backed CoAP transport (coap_cantcoap_client/coap_cantcoap_server, include/raft/coap_transport_cantcoap_impl.hpp). cantcoap is a PDU codec only, so this backend owns the socket, reliability, block-wise and security itself, reusing kythira's existing scaffolding. Built from source via the vcpkg-overlays/cantcoap overlay port, which vendors a CMakeLists because upstream ships no build system. Opt-in and additive: omitting it leaves CANTCOAP_AVAILABLE undefined with everything else unaffected.

coap-libnyoci.description: Alternate libnyoci-backed CoAP transport (coap_libnyoci_client/coap_libnyoci_server, include/raft/coap_transport_libnyoci_impl.hpp) alongside the default libcoap-backed one. Builds libnyoci from source via the vcpkg-overlays/libnyoci overlay port. Opt-in and additive: it does not replace libcoap, and omitting it leaves LIBNYOCI_AVAILABLE undefined with everything else unaffected. Building it needs the autotools chain plus autoconf-archive on the host — see vcpkg-overlays/libnyoci/README.md.
